project_title: Product Drive CMS - Hardened PHP & Bootstrap Admin Visual System
archetype: ARCHETYPE 2: PERFORMANCE PRO & ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS PRECISION

theme_strategy.toggle_mechanism: data-bs-theme attribute on <html> element with localStorage persistence and system media query sync script in <head>

rules.headings: font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; tracking: tight (-0.02em); letter spacing is tight for headers above 24px.

layout_architecture.spacing_scale: High Density Mode B. Use generous padding (p-4 to p-6 inside cards, gap-4 to gap-6 between grid widgets).
layout_architecture.responsive_behavior: Sidebar collapses into offcanvas drawer on screens < 992px with hamburger toggle button in topbar.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used on sticky topbar and modal headers: backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(150%); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--card-border).
visual_enhancers.card_styling: Flat background with 1px precise border, subtle inset highlight on hover, rounded-3 (8px radius). No heavy box shadows.

micro_interactions.buttons: transition: all 0.15s ease-in-out; transform active state: scale(0.98); focus ring: 0 0 0 3px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3);
micro_interactions.table_rows: hover transition: background-color 0.15s ease; cursor pointer on actionable rows.
micro_interactions.stat_cards: hover lift: translateY(-2px); border color brightens slightly.

navigation.sidebar: Dark high-contrast theme with brand badge at top, organized section headers (MAIN, CATALOG, SYSTEM), active indicator bar on left border.
navigation.topbar: Search command pill, CSRF indicator badge, quick product add action button, user dropdown menu with role pill badge (Admin / Operator).

data_tables.style: Bordered table with subtle horizontal grid lines, sticky header, responsive wrapper with overflow-x-auto.
data_tables.elements: Thumbnail preview column (40x40 rounded image with lightbox/hover preview), status badges, action icons (Edit, View, Delete with CSRF token in form/modal).

forms.style: Input fields with subtle 1px border, floating labels or high-legibility bold top labels, password toggle visibility icon button, drag-and-drop file upload area with live image thumbnail preview.
forms.validation: Server-rendered inline feedback (.invalid-feedback) + client-side HTML5 validation styling.

flash_alerts.container: Top right floating toast container or embedded page banner alert.
flash_alerts.style: Dismissible Bootstrap alerts styled with left accent border (4px solid color matching success/danger/warning) and auto-fade out with vanilla JS.

empty_states.design: Centered subtle box with mono-colored SVG icon, muted title, clear action button (e.g., 'Add First Product').

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, input fields, tables, forms, buttons, alerts, and navigation links MUST have explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case format (e.g. data-testid="login-submit-btn", data-testid="product-search-input", data-testid="product-row-12").
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_ratio: APCA / WCAG 2.1 AA compliant text against card backgrounds. Minimum 4.5:1 ratio.
testing_and_accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Visible focus ring (2px blue offset) on all inputs, buttons, and custom toggles.

instructions_to_main_agent: Rebuild 'Product Drive CMS' in clean PHP 8+ with PDO MySQL/MariaDB and Bootstrap 5.3+.

Implement all required hardening measures: Password hashing (password_hash/password_verify), CSRF protection tokens on all POST/PUT/DELETE forms, Prepared statements against SQL injection, HTML entity escaping (htmlspecialchars) against XSS, Session fixation protection and strict RBAC authorization (Admin vs Operator).

Apply the visual system specified above using custom CSS overriding Bootstrap CSS custom variables (--bs-body-bg, --bs-body-color, etc.) in a main custom stylesheet (e.g. assets/css/custom-theme.css).
Include data-testid on all key UI elements across all PHP templates.
Provide full product CRUD, image upload with preview, user management with role editing, category management, profile settings, search & filter, and dashboard summary stats.
